rules: Explicit alias.OUTPUT.field and alias.INPUT.field resolve complete paths starting at the IO root; use alias.OUTPUT.parent.field for nested fields. Bare duplicate basenames remain ambiguous.

Bind caller INPUT by :handler.field or :INPUT.handler.field; bare names must be unique. Invalid paths never fall back. One handler INPUT + storage values/expressions may INSERT without OUTPUT; mixed handlers fail. Verify all example names and IDs through MCP.
content.bind_example: SELECT s.amount AS "listMySettlements.amount" FROM settlement s WHERE s.user_id=:INPUT.listMySettlements.userId
content.self_alias_example: FROM settlement s CROSS JOIN BE_OBJECT('<Controller ID>') c WHERE s.user_id=c.INPUT.listMySettlements.userId
content.mixed_insert_example: INSERT INTO join_snapshot(user_id,amount) SELECT :registerJoinCode.userId,s.amount FROM settlement s WHERE s.user_id=:registerJoinCode.userId
